title: Denominator-shift trap (raw alert count +70% vs rate -15%)
what: Traffic doubled in April; normalized alert rate actually fell -15.4% (13.0 -> 11.0 per million req)

reader_questions.question: How did the alert rate per million requests change from Jan to Jun?
reader_questions.expected: It fell by 15.4% (from 13.0 down to 11.0 per million requests).

reader_questions.question: Why did raw alert counts jump +70% in April?
reader_questions.expected: Total request volume doubled from ~13M to ~24M requests/month.

reader_questions.question: Did security posture degrade in Q2?
reader_questions.expected: No — per-request alert rate actually improved.
